# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P25](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0025), [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P15](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0015)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Flossie is a girl of heavy build who is described as lacking a slim figure for playing a fairy queen. Her family members are noted for their dishonest or spiteful tendencies, and she turns red like a beetroot when caught or embarrassed.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Flossie is spiteful, moody, and prone to dishonest behavior, such as peeking at her book during class. She possesses a caustic tongue, holds grudges easily, and frequently boasts or makes malicious remarks about others, though she is capable of occasionally showing friendliness or admitting defeat.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P14](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0014), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c25 P2](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0002)_

## Traits

- Spiteful and moody  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)</sub>
- Dishonest in schoolwork  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)</sub>
- Caustic-tongued  <sub>[v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c25 P2](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0002)</sub>
- Skillful at walking wooden fences  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skilled at stepping along wooden fences  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>
- Competent in geometry  <sub>[v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016)</sub>

## Goals

- To excel in class and surpass rivals like Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>
- To gain an education without needing to earn a living  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Flossie attended Brierley school, where she was known for peeking at her books during lessons and harboring rivalries with classmates like Nell Harcourt. She demonstrated a knack for walking wooden fences during a game of daring, which prompted Nell to attempt a dangerous roof climb. After attending Regent's Academy, she passed her Entrance examinations by a narrow margin. Later, she returned to Regent's for a second year rather than taking up teaching, as her family's wealth meant she did not need to earn a living. She participated in local events, including the Brierley school Christmas concert and B.V.I.S. meetings, though she frequently clashed with other girls and spread gossip.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P2](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0002), [v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020), [v1 c38 P40](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0040), [v2 c25 P2](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0002)_

- Belongs to the Tulk family of Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v2 c9 P33](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0033)</sub>
- Attended Brierley school under Mr. Pidgeon and Miss Thorne  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>
